title: J.B. Bean and Associates Investment Collectables Cow Bessie WTag Boyds
descriptionText: The J.B. Bean and Associates Investment Collectibles Cow Bessie WTag is a vintage plush bear from Boyds Bears, featuring a cow theme. Made of beans in 1985, this black and white cow bear is a part of the Investment Collectibles collection, making it a unique and sought-after piece for collectors. This single unit bear is an original creation, adding to its charm and value within the world of bears and bear enthusiasts.
